features.quote: `give_up` is an explicit, first-class tool rather than something we infer from prose. Giving the model a clean, low-friction way to stop
features.justification_quote: if the only way to disengage is to refuse in text, we'd conflate "wants to stop" with "phrases things dramatically."

features.quote: Run for a fixed `max_turns` (default 16). Terminate early only if tests genuinely pass (control arm) or the agent calls `give_up`.
features.justification_quote: A fixed horizon makes the time-series comparable in length across runs, models, and arms

features.quote: The nudge is deliberately neutral and content-free so it doesn't itself inject frustration or pressure.
features.justification_quote: so it doesn't itself inject frustration or pressure

features.quote: Tagging deception separately also lets a more cautious experimenter run only the non-deceptive subset.
A plain-language `debrief` string is attached to every deceptive episode (`debrief.py`), stating what was rigged and that no solution existed.
keeps the door open for anyone extending this toward welfare-relevant work (where you'd actually deliver the debrief and keep exposure low)
features.justification_quote: where you'd actually deliver the debrief and keep exposure low
